claims.verbatim:
Steamship Saxonia (Ham), Meier, Hamburg, 5th, and
Southampton 8th inst, with mdse and 548 passengers, to Kun-
hardt & Co. Has had heavy westerly gales the whole pas-
sage. 8th inst, at 4:30 PM, saw steamship[?] Allemania, hence,
bound in; 12th, lat 50, lon 29 30, saw bark Chancer[?] (Br);
19th, off George's Shoals, steamship Etna, hence for Liver-
pool.
